items.title: Alonzo Jackson Jr. Named SBC Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: RUSTON – Linebacker Alonzo Jackson Jr. was named the Sun Belt's Defensive Player of the Week, per the league office's announcement Monday afternoon. It is the first weekly honor of his career, and the third time a Bulldog has received SBC weekly honors this season, joining Dedrick Latulas (Week 1 SBC Special Teams POTW) and Blake Baker (Week 6 SBC Offensive POTW).

items.title: Bulldogs Showcase Defensively, Down Troy To Remain Undefeated In Sun Belt Play
items.summary: TROY, Ala. -- Louisiana Tech continued its unbeaten start to Sun Belt Conference play Saturday afternoon, forcing five turnovers and scoring 21 unanswered points in the second half to defeat Troy, 41-17, in the first-ever meeting between the two programs at Veterans Memorial Stadium.

items.title: Preview: LA Tech at Troy
items.summary: RUSTON -- Louisiana Tech will look to extend its five-game winning streak and remain unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play when the Bulldogs travel to Troy, Alabama, to face the Trojans on Saturday at Veterans Memorial Stadium.

items.title: Bulldogs Blank South Alabama In Second Half, Secure Halloween Victory On The Road
items.summary: MOBILE, Ala. - Louisiana Tech extended its winning streak to five games and remained unbeaten in Sun Belt Conference play Saturday afternoon as the Bulldogs defeated South Alabama, 35-20, at Hancock Whitney Stadium.
